concerns.text: FR-003 mandates descriptors computed 'on log-ratio transformed composition data', but T004 explicitly computes physical descriptors 'from RAW weight percentages' with CLR used only as model input. No task delivers FR-003 as written; either a task must compute descriptors on CLR-transformed data or the spec must be amended.

FR-001 requires aggregation from 'Materials Project, NIST, OpenAlloy, published literature, and systematic literature review', but T001 builds the dataset exclusively from open-access published literature. The database sources are dropped with no spec amendment; no task covers that half of FR-001.

FR-011 requires sampling 'if needed' when the dataset exceeds RAM/disk capacity. T012 only measures usage against the budget; no task implements or even defines a sampling mechanism, so FR-011's conditional action is uncovered.

plan.md's core acquisition element (Literature Aggregator scraping cited PDFs from a 'Verified Literature Corpus' via code/ingestion/aggregator.py) has no matching task — tasks.md explicitly rejects it in favor of the curated CSV. An implementer following plan.md cannot find a task for the plan's central ingestion element; the plan must be updated or the divergence documented in the spec.
